content.short: Solsniffer provides advanced token sniffer and wallet portfolio tracking on Solana for secure trading analysis.
content.description: Solsniffer delivers in-depth security analysis for tokens and advanced wallet portfolio tracking on Solana. Since its February 2024 launch, the platform uses sophisticated algorithms to detect suspicious activity, scam patterns, and potential risks, supporting crypto traders, investors, and platforms seeking robust API datasets. Its wallet-tracking features help flag top performers, known scammers, and possible insider trading signals, empowering Solana users to make informed decisions through on-chain data.
